top_signals.title: Carney Expands Business Tax Break to Broad Range of Investments
top_signals.summary: Prime Minister Mark Carney is expanding the scope of a major investment tax write-off, adding oil and gas pipelines, mining property and more to the list of assets eligible for accelerated deductions in Canada.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: AMC-Robinhood Feud Tests Who Gets to Put Stocks on Blockchains
top_signals.summary: Five years after Adam Aron and Vlad Tenev became two of the defining figures of the meme-stock boom, the AMC Entertainment Holdings Inc. chief and Robinhood Markets Inc. co-founder are clashing over a new question: who gets to create a tradable version of a public company’s stock?
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Piero Cipollone: The future of euro cash: trusted today, designed for tomorrow
Zama expands confidential Morpho lineup after first vault hits $40 million, launches private swaps on Ethereum
top_signals.summary: Users get confidential access to 12 existing Morpho vaults on Ethereum, while another four have been created as confidential-only products.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
